# Track

The milestone track.

`LL.Track` · Components · Data

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Track steps={0} current={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Track" steps="{{0}}" current="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (TrackProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` * | `number` |  |
| `current` * | `number` | Zero-based index of the current step; earlier steps are done. |
| `startLabel` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `endLabel` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `labels` | `string[]` | Per-step names, used for tooltips and aria-valuetext. |
| `tone` | `'gilt' \| 'hp' \| 'arcana'` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
